ad_info.reference_style: Clean, modern progress ad: three circular photo frames of increasing size threaded on one horizontal timeline, showing the same subject improving over three moments, with the product anchoring the bottom

global_identity.color_palette: Primary: hot pink #E91E78 and glossy black #0E0E10. Secondary: deep magenta #A80F55, soft pink #F7A8C9, blush pink background #FCE3EE, pure white #FFFFFF for text and outlines. Small warm accent from the aguaje fruit: orange #F28A1E. In this ad the background is blush pink with a very subtle gradient, the timeline goes from soft pink to hot pink, and the final pill, ring and glow of the third circle use hot pink. The photos inside the circles keep natural tones, from cooler and muted in stage 1 to warmer and more vivid in stage 3.
global_identity.visual_style: Bold, feminine, high-contrast LATAM direct-response supplement ad: glossy pink and black graphics combined with realistic, candid smartphone-style fitness photos of adult women.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Energetic, confident, feminine and motivating; bright and clean, with the feeling of a real result shown by a real woman.
global_identity.graphic_language: Pink gradients with soft brush strokes, rounded photo frames with white borders, pill-shaped labels, small rounded icon badges in deep magenta, thick white outlines on headlines, glossy reflections, small heart accents, strong contrast between pink, black and white.
global_identity.text_typography: Poppins Bold (extra bold, uppercase) for headlines and prices; Poppins Regular / SemiBold for the rest of the text.

creative_objective: Make the viewer read the transformation as a month-by-month journey in one glance: three round photos of the same woman, same framing, that grow from left to right (Día 1, Mes 1, Mes 3) with a gradual, believable gain of volume in glutes and legs, tied to the bottle standing at the bottom.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) Bold headline at the top. 2) The three circular photos read left to right as growth: small, medium, large, with the largest (final result) circle ringed in hot pink. 3) The user's bottle centered in the bottom band. 4) The small time-label pills on top of each circle and the short caption under each one.
art_direction.composition_style: Horizontal left-to-right progression with deliberate size growth. Headline centered in the top band. Three circular photo frames sit side by side with their centers on the same horizontal line at about 46% of the canvas height: circle 1 is about 20% of the canvas width in diameter (centered at about 17% of the canvas width), circle 2 about 25% (centered at about 43%), circle 3 about 32% (centered at about 75%). Equal gaps of about 3.5% of the canvas width separate the circles. A thin timeline track runs behind the circles through their centers, with a small chevron arrow pointing right in each gap. A rounded time-label pill straddles the top edge of each circle, centered on it. A one-line caption sits centered under each circle on a shared baseline. The bottle stands centered in the bottom band, about 21% of the canvas height.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Vertical bands: headline from about 6% to 19% of the canvas height; breathing space down to the top of circle 3 at about 30%; circles between about 30% and 62% (circle 1 spans about 36-56%, circle 2 about 33.5-58.5%, circle 3 about 30-62%); captions on one shared baseline from about 65% to 71%; product band from about 74% to 95%. Horizontally, circle 1 spans about 7-27% of the canvas width, circle 2 about 30.5-55.5% and circle 3 about 59-91%. Safe margins of about 6-7% on every side. Nothing touches the canvas edges and nothing overlaps the photos except the label pills on their top edge.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Inside the circles: identical camera angle, crop and outdoor terrace setting across all three stages so only the progression changes; stage 1 slightly cooler and more muted (overcast late-afternoon feel), stage 2 neutral, stage 3 warmest and most vibrant golden afternoon light. Each circle has a thin white outline and a soft drop shadow so it floats slightly above the background; circle 3 adds a hot-pink ring (about 1% of the canvas width thick) and a faint pink glow. The bottle in the bottom band gets a soft studio key light from the upper left, a subtle rim light and a soft contact shadow on an implied surface.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Square canvas with a blush-pink background. Two-line headline centered at the top. Across the middle, three circular photos of the same woman at three moments of a visible, believable progression grow in size from left to right (small, medium, large) along a thin horizontal timeline track that runs through their centers, with a small chevron arrow in each gap. A small rounded time-label pill (Día 1, Mes 1, Mes 3) sits on the top edge of each circle, and the largest circle is ringed in hot pink. A short caption sits under each circle on a shared baseline. The user's bottle stands centered in the bottom band with a soft shadow.

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 social media ad for a women's supplement, built as a three-stage growing-circles timeline. BACKGROUND: full-canvas blush pink (#FCE3EE) with a very subtle gradient toward soft pink (#F7A8C9) at the bottom, clean and low-detail, never white. Safe margins of about 6-7% on every side. HEADLINE (top center, from about 6% to 19% of the canvas height): two centered lines of extra-bold uppercase Poppins, each line about 6% of the canvas height, in glossy black (#0E0E10) with the last three words 'MES A MES' in hot pink (#E91E78). TIMELINE TRACK: a thin horizontal line (about 0.5% of the canvas height) at about 46% of the canvas height, running from about 6% to 94% of the canvas width behind the circles and through their centers, shifting from soft pink on the left to hot pink on the right, with one small right-pointing chevron arrow centered in each of the two gaps between circles; the line is visible only in the gaps and at both ends. THREE CIRCULAR PHOTOS with their centers on that same line, growing from left to right with equal gaps of about 3.5% of the canvas width: circle 1 about 20% of the canvas width in diameter (spanning about 7-27% of the width, 36-56% of the height); circle 2 about 25% (30.5-55.5% of the width, 33.5-58.5% of the height); circle 3 about 32% (59-91% of the width, 30-62% of the height). Each circle has a thin white outline and a soft drop shadow; circle 3 also has a hot-pink ring about 1% of the canvas width thick and a faint pink glow. All three circles show the same adult Latina woman, about 25 years old, light-brown skin, in a realistic, candid smartphone-style fitness progress photo: seen from behind in a three-quarter view, framed from the waist to mid-thigh, standing on an open-air apartment terrace with a railing, potted plants and a soft blurred city view in late-afternoon light; she wears mauve high-waist sports leggings and the hem of a white t-shirt, and the tip of her long light-brown braid is visible at the top of the frame. Same camera angle, crop, outfit and place in all three photos, only scaled up from circle to circle; tasteful, fully clothed, natural adult proportions. Circle 1 (starting point): flatter glutes and slimmer thighs, slightly cooler and more muted tones. Circle 2 (first change): a slight, believable gain of roundness in glutes and thighs, neutral tones. Circle 3 (result): visibly fuller, rounder glutes and thighs with the same waist, warm and vibrant golden afternoon light; a realistic improvement, never exaggerated. The product does not appear inside any circle. TIME-LABEL PILLS: one small rounded pill straddling the top edge of each circle, centered on it, all about 4.5% of the canvas height, with bold white text: pills 1 and 2 filled with glossy black, pill 3 filled with hot pink. CAPTIONS: one single-line caption centered under each circle, all three on one shared baseline between about 65% and 71% of the canvas height, about 2.8% of the canvas height tall: captions 1 and 2 in glossy black Poppins Medium, caption 3 in deep magenta (#A80F55) Poppins SemiBold. PRODUCT (bottom center, from about 74% to 95% of the canvas height): one single bottle from the attached image, front view, standing upright on an implied surface with a soft contact shadow, lit by a soft studio key light from the upper left with a subtle rim light, about 21% of the canvas height, sharply in focus. The product is a cylindrical glossy black plastic supplement bottle with softly rounded shoulders, about twice as tall as it is wide, closed with a hot-pink ribbed screw cap, wrapped in a glossy black label that ends in a solid bright pink band at the very bottom; the label shows a small pink-and-white 'VITALABH' logo, the word 'AGUAJE' in very large bold white uppercase letters, 'COMPLEX' in bold white and '3 EN 1' in bold hot pink on the same line, a thin hot-pink strip with small white text, the words 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' in bold italic hot pink with a swoosh underline, a row of three small pink-outlined rounded boxes joined by white plus signs, and '60 CÁPSULAS' in bold white at the bottom. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the bottle: same shape, cap, label, texts and colors; do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it; ignore the hand and the video player bar visible in that photo and show only the bottle. All visible text in Spanish, spelled exactly as given, with correct accents. No price, no CTA button, no badges, no icons, no stars, no charts, no subheadline, no extra circles, no extra text.
